target_customer: Pharma partners and patients: develops RNA-targeting small molecule drugs and partners programs with pharma
problem: Many disease drivers lie in RNA that antibodies and conventional small molecules cannot reach, so they are considered undruggable.
business_model: Drug discovery with pharma partnerships (milestone payments) and an internal preclinical pipeline
product_category: Biotech, RNA-targeted small molecule drug discovery

founders.name: Rabia Khan
education: PhD and MBA (institutions not stated on the company site)
founders.background_notes: YC page: built the ML team at Sensyne Health; company site says 15+ years at the intersection of AI, genetics and biotech.

competitors.name: Arrakis Therapeutics
competitors.what: RNA-targeted small molecule drug discovery, founded 2015 in Waltham, Massachusetts
competitors.traction_then: Venture-backed company with a platform to find RNA-binding small molecules

technical_complexity.rationale: Drugging RNA structure with small molecules is research-grade science needing wet lab chemistry and biology.

defensibility.rationale: Platform data on RNA small molecule interactions and drug patents can be protective, but several funded rivals pursued the same target class.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Funded RNA-targeting startups continued independently; Serna later signed a Chiesi collaboration in July 2025 per CB Insights.

market_need_then: RNA drug targets were a recognized frontier after mRNA vaccines and splicing drugs; the BioPharma Dive piece counts at least eight startups in the field, though its date is unknown.

identity.voice_and_tone: Scientific; taglines Beyond inhibition. Beyond the proteome. and Biology Is Vast. We Make It Druggable.

branding.brand_signature: Biology Is Vast. We Make It Druggable.

rebrands.why: Not stated; a SERNA BIO trademark was filed Feb 2023 by Ladder Therapeutics, Inc. per a trademark listing

brand_strength.rationale: Short coinage that hints at serna for RNA, but no press about the brand and similar names such as Seerna exist.

outcome_analysis: Serna Bio, formerly Ladder Therapeutics, stayed active with a small team, a preclinical ALS program and a Chiesi respiratory collaboration reported in July 2025. Disclosed funding is small and unverified, so it appears to be a long-running seed-stage biotech funded through partnerships rather than a large venture round.
notes: Funding: aggregators disagree (Caplight 625K seed Jan 2022; CB Insights about 500K over 5 rounds including a business plan competition prize; Extruct 0.1M), none verified by press, so no rounds recorded. The Chiesi deal is undisclosed in amount and came from a CB Insights news item with a truncated snippet. Competitor Arrakis is sourced to a 2017 BioCentury item; Skyhawk and others have only undated pages and are not listed. Rebrand date unknown. CB Insights lists Toronto as location, YC says San Francisco. A different company named Ladder Bio (formerly ThirdLaw Molecular) was excluded. Name coinage hypothesis (serna for RNA) is not sourced, so name_origin is null. Completeness pass: the 125K accelerator award (2021-01) rests on Extruct alone and the 625K seed (2022-01) on Caplight alone; CB Insights totals about 500K over 5 rounds, so totals conflict. The May 2025 Astellas Future Innovator Prize is confirmed by a press release and is an in-kind award (lab bench and mentoring), amount null. The July 2025 Chiesi collaboration (press release) pays undisclosed success-based and milestone payments and is not recorded as a round.
